import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('table_name.csv')
# Define the column name for sorting
final_rank_column = 'Indices of Deprivation 2015 - South East U.A.s (n.b. Rank 1 = most deprived).10'
# Sort the dataframe by the final rank column in ascending order
sorted_df = df.sort_values(by=final_rank_column, ascending=True)
# Save the sorted dataframe to a CSV file
sorted_df.to_csv('output.csv', index=False)
